choices.label: Buy signal oil (pay 40 cinders; aid the caravan)
choices.resultText: The wick catches. The Road Warden records forty cinders beside Lantern Haven in a weathered supply ledger.

choices.label: Haul the beacon (take 8 damage; aid the caravan)
choices.resultText: The iron frame cuts your palms, but its light clears the ridge. The Road Warden waves Lantern Haven’s wagons through and promises to remember the work.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You pass the unlit lantern. The caravan must find another way.

view.text:
An unmarked routekeeper braces a broken signal lantern against the rain. The drivers call this traveler the Road Warden; there is no Fell Courtyard crest on the coat.

"That caravan carries medicine to Lantern Haven and the cold hamlets beyond. Oil costs forty cinders. Or help me haul the spare beacon up the scree."
view.title: The Last Lantern

choices.label: Accept the quartermaster’s lesson (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The quartermaster shows you the economy of a practiced motion. Your investment returns as knowledge.

choices.label: Steal the emergency strongbox (gain 100 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: No one stops you. A driver crosses the medicine purchase off Lantern Haven’s manifest. The hamlets’ names remain beneath it, with nothing beside them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You wave the wagons onward, asking nothing in return.

view.text:
The Road Warden stands beside Lantern Haven’s mud-spattered wagons. The last one carries the lantern you helped raise.

"You bought these people a road. We can pay our debt. That strongbox is for medicine at the next trading post; it belongs to the cold hamlets."
view.title: The Caravan Comes Through
